title: Intuit Mailchimp
snippet:
# Intuit Mailchimp
ai-inc.mailchimp.com/claude/mcp/v2
Go from business goals to omnichannel campaigns in seconds. Provide your business goals, and we'll generate a data-backed omnichannel strategy with ready-to-use layouts, not just the text, to ensure brand consistency while saving you hours of manual work. Ready to send? Simply connect or create a Mailchimp account to import your assets and reach your audience.

Add Intuit Mailchimp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-inc.mailchimp.com/claude/mcp/v2. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
Intuit Mailchimp provides these MCP tools: campaign-planner, edit-campaign, save-to-mailchimp, get-email-themes, replace-image, edit-text, apply-theme, set-active-campaign, get-enrichment, get-campaign-content, generate-image, and scrape-product-images.
As of November 10, 2026, alternatives to Intuit Mailchimp in marketing-seo on the [Manufact MCP leaderboard](/leaderboard/all) include Refluenced, The Prompting Company MCP, Buzzfy, Indexing Dispatch, and Brave URL Submitter.
Intuit Mailchimp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
[Intuit Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/) is developed by Intuit Mailchimp. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.

title: Mailchimp MCP Servers: Tools, Setup and Security
snippet:
Mailchimp has three official MCP options, and they do different jobs. The Intuit Mailchimp connector in Claude plans and builds campaigns. The Mailchimp Transactional server, at `https://mandrillapp.com/mcp`, works with the Mandrill email API. A third server only searches Mailchimp's developer docs.

- The Intuit Mailchimp connector in Claude has 12 tools for planning, editing and saving campaigns. Work is saved as drafts in Mailchimp.

- Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) has its own server with 9 tools, including `call_api`, which can send email.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Publisher | Intuit Mailchimp |
| Official? | Yes |
| Hosting | Remote URLs (hosted by Mailchimp) |
| Transport | HTTP |
| Sign-in | Connector: Mailchimp sign-in. Transactional: API key as Bearer token |
| Read or write | Connector saves drafts; Transactional can call any API endpoint |
| Price | No separate MCP price listed |
| Source code | Not published |
| Status | Connector added to Claude's directory March 2026 |

title: mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/build/ai-tools/mcp-server.md
snippet:
> For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server.
# MCP server
> Query these docs from an AI agent through the Model Context Protocol.
> **Note**
>
> **This searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account.** The server
> answers questions using this site's published content, so it works without a
> Mailchimp credential. To let an agent act on your account, call the API
> directly or use [Agent skills](/marketing/build/ai-tools/agent-skills).
[Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) (MCP) is an open
standard that lets an AI agent discover and call an external server's tools
during a conversation.
This documentation site is itself an MCP server. Connect an agent to it and
the agent can search these docs directly from your editor or terminal instead
of you copying passages into the conversation by hand.

**Claude Code**
```bash
claude mcp add --transport http fern_mcp_mailchimp-docs \
https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server
```
**Cursor**
Add the URL to your MCP server configuration:
```
https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server
```
**Claude Desktop**
Open Claude menu → Settings → Developer → Edit Config, then add the server
under `mcpServers` in `claude_desktop_config.json`:
```json
{
"mcpServers": {
"mailchimp-docs": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server"
}
}
}
```
**VS Code**
Add the same server to `.vscode/mcp.json` in your project:
```json
{
"servers": {
"mailchimp-docs": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server"
}
}
}
```
Restart the client after saving. Each one surfaces a connection indicator
once the server responds.

title: Mailchimp MCP: Official Connectors, Community Servers and an Alternative
snippet:
**Short answer:** Mailchimp doesn't have one general-purpose MCP server for its marketing product. It has three partial options:
1. **The Intuit Mailchimp connector** for Claude, plus a Mailchimp app in ChatGPT. Both plan and design campaigns and save them to Mailchimp. Neither sends.
2. **The Mailchimp Transactional MCP server**, for the Mandrill transactional email add-on. It can send, but only transactional email.
3. **Community MCP servers** that wrap the Marketing API with an API key. Some can send campaigns, with the risks that come with an unofficial tool.

## The Intuit Mailchimp connector for Claude and ChatGPT
In 2026 Intuit added Mailchimp apps to ChatGPT (launched in March) and Claude, where the connector is listed as "Intuit Mailchimp" and marked Anthropic verified. In May 2026 Intuit made them available in the US, Canada, the UK and Australia.
**What it does:** it's a campaign planner and designer. The Claude connector's tools plan a campaign, apply your email theme, edit text, swap and generate images, pull product images from your site, and save the result to Mailchimp.
**What it doesn't do:** it doesn't send or schedule. It shows no tools for your audience, subscribers or reports, so you can't ask it how last week's campaign did. You open Mailchimp to review and launch what it saved.
**Setup:** in Claude, open the connectors menu, find **Intuit Mailchimp**, click **Connect** and sign in to Mailchimp. In ChatGPT, search for Mailchimp in the app directory and add it.
**Plans:** Mailchimp's pages disagree. Its AI tools page says the connectors are "available on Standard and Premium plans". Its ChatGPT guide says you "don't need to be on a specific plan". Check your account before you count on it.
2
## The Mailchimp Transactional MCP server
Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) has its own documented MCP server, hosted at `https://mandrillapp.com/mcp`. You connect with a Transactional API key as a Bearer token. Mailchimp gives setup steps for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code:
Bash
```bash
claude mcp add --transport http mctx-mcp https://mandrillapp.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```
It can send transactional messages, manage templates and help diagnose failed sends. It's useful for developers. But it doesn't touch your marketing audience or campaigns, and Transactional is a paid add-on for Standard and Premium plans.
3
